server._comment: sync server (MOBILE.md). host 'tailscale' binds to the tailnet IP (falls back to 127.0.0.1 when tailscale is absent); set a random token and put the same one in the phone app's Settings.

asr._comment: engine: auto | gpu | reazonspeech | elevenlabs. 'auto' prefers the desktop GPU service (Kotoba-Whisper) for Japanese when gpu_url is set, then CPU ReazonSpeech, then ElevenLabs. If the GPU host is unreachable it falls back automatically. Only human-uploaded YouTube subs are trusted; auto-captions are re-transcribed. See gpu_service/README.md.

discover._comment: /recommend (ytSearch). format_blocklist drops candidates whose title or channel contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive) — a personal taste filter for formats you can't watch, e.g. the ゆっくり / VOICEROID synthetic-TTS narrators. Omit the key entirely to use the built-in default list (tools/harvest.py DEFAULT_FORMAT_BLOCKLIST); set [] to disable filtering. Use the format compounds (ゆっくり解説, 【ゆっくり) not bare ゆっくり, which also means 'leisurely' (a ゆっくり散歩 walking vlog must not be filtered). channel_blocklist hard-blocks specific channel_ids. After editing, run: python -m tools.harvest refilter.

library._comment: tools.library: the Raspberry Pi media server (192.168.0.147, 'mediaserver'). Its SMB shares are mounted on the Mac as network drives: `library` (the Japanese media — read-only user data) and `t7` (scratch; our 480p stage copies). The login is in the keychain; the tools re-mount a dropped share themselves (Finder's mount volume). legacy_roots maps the desktop-era paths in old manifests / muscle memory onto the mount.

manga._comment: tools.manga: the desktop is only the GPU box now — the pages come off the media server mount (library.manga_root) and are parked on the PC over ssh just for the boxing (mokuro in remote_python + remote_script = gpu_service/ocr_volume.py deployed to I:/transcribe), under remote_src_dir; per-volume JSON is cached under remote_ocr_dir.

deck.name: Immersion Mining
deck._comment_volume: There is deliberately no cards-per-day/per-episode cap: card volume is an outcome of the curation quality bar (zero from an episode is fine), never of a count.
deck._comment_audio_gate: Push-time clip validation: each card's cut clip is re-transcribed on the GPU service (asr.gpu_url) and the card is dropped unless the sentence is actually audible (matched-chars/expected >= min_match after kana/punctuation normalization). On by default when gpu_url is set; fails open if the desktop is unreachable.
deck._comment_loudness: Card audio clips are loudness-normalized to this integrated loudness (LUFS) so volume is consistent across episodes when reviewing. Set to null to keep the source volume untouched.
deck._comment: note_type/field_map are optional: omit them to mint onto the built-in 'fullPipe Sentence Mining' model (auto-created). Set them to mint onto your own note type (must already exist in Anki). field_map keys: sentence, audio, english, image, lemma, reading, source, sequence — map only the fields your note type has. A value may be a list of field names (e.g. below: Anki requires the FIRST field of a note non-empty, so the sentence fills it too).

autopilot._comment: /autopilot (skills/autopilot): YouTube-only watchable stock. Below min_hours the loop curates prepared jobs and runs /recommend to refill the pipeline to target_hours (hysteresis). Cooldown stops back-to-back harvests. max_parallel_curate = Opus subagents per wave.
